title: lupinus kingii var. argillaceus
intro: Lupinus kingii var. argillaceus, commonly known as Argillaceous Lupine or Argillaceous Bluebonnet, is a subspecies of the Lupinus kingii plant, which is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve heart health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Argillaceous Lupine include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve anxiety and insomnia, and support the immune system, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Lupinus kingii var. argillaceus include alkaloids, such as lupanine, sparteine, and angustifoline, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
